# ZenStory AI

> Open-source AI tools and agent skills for story creation, adaptation, and production. Create stories. Adapt them. Ship them — from web fiction and short drama to games and video. Everything is MIT-licensed and maintained at https://github.com/zenstory-ai.

ZenStory AI (GitHub org `zenstory-ai`) publishes six projects. Five are skill packs / plugins for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Google Antigravity, OpenCode, ZCode, OpenClaw, Kimi Code and DeepSeek Harness; one is a hosted writing workbench. Choose by the material and deliverable: plan or revise fiction, adapt a story into short drama or a game, or turn footage into narrated video. Projects have separate setup and workspace requirements; this is not an automatic cross-product pipeline.

Canonical install path for the skill packs is the GitHub repository under `zenstory-ai/` (e.g. `npx skills add zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`). Repositories were previously hosted under `worldwonderer/`; those paths permanently redirect here.

## Projects

Overview page: https://zenstory.ai/projects — each project has a bilingual canonical page with its definition, audience, workflow, capability limits and dated, versioned source notes. Those notes identify the reviewed source snapshot, not a guarantee about later releases.

- [Oh Story (oh-story-claudecode)](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode): Thirteen agent skills for web-fiction research, deconstruction, drafting, revision and covers. Chart data depends on available sources; historical fallback is labeled. Pattern checks do not establish authorship or guarantee AI-detector scores. Host capabilities determine orchestration support.
- [Drama Skills (drama-skills)](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills): Eleven skills for short-drama and motion-comic scripts, visual specifications, storyboards and generation prompts. Documents and stages are selected as needed. Media production requires configured providers and explicit spending confirmation; review is separately requested.
- [Novel to Game (novel-to-game)](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/novel-to-game): Seven agent skills for source-grounded adaptation into a game candidate on a selected target runtime. Six runtime QA checks record execution evidence, not subjective quality or readiness for commercial release.
- [Video Recap Skills (video-recap-skills)](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/video-recap-skills): Six skills total — five stage skills plus one orchestrator — for Chinese-narration video recaps and optional CapCut/JianYing draft export. ffmpeg processes media locally; MiMo and optional Fish Audio services handle remote model tasks. Final output requires playback review.
- [Oh Story DSH (oh-story-dsh)](https://zenstory.ai/dsh) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-dsh): A community DeepSeek Harness plugin with pinned novel, short-drama, game and video skill packs and four workbenches. The local DSH Web environment and model/media services require configuration. Package: `@oh-story/dsh`; not affiliated with, partnered with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
- [ZenStory workbench (zenstory)](https://zenstory.ai/workbench) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/zenstory): A conversation-first writing workspace for project files, materials, characters, drafts and version history. Hosted at https://app.zenstory.ai; self-hosting requires backend/model configuration. See the project page for version limits and the published privacy-policy statement.

## Documentation

- [Agent skills for writers: prompts, skill packs, plugins and MCP](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers): a non-programmer guide to the different layers, when a prompt is enough, choosing a task from an idea or existing manuscript, and an original outline-first writing brief.
- [Write a novel with DeepSeek: chat, DSH plugin or workbench](https://zenstory.ai/dsh/deepseek-novel-writing): choose the right environment, prepare the DSH workspace, start a novel and continue saved work; distinguishes the model, host and community plugin.
- [Choose a writing workflow](https://zenstory.ai/compare/writing-workflows): first-party comparison of Oh Story skills, the pinned DSH plugin and hosted ZenStory; host/configuration/file/version boundaries and a reversible trial checklist, not a ranking or price/privacy guarantee.
- [Novel-to-game quick start](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start): authorized inputs, host-specific entry, product brief, expected files and six-check runtime verification.
- [Export a JianYing / CapCut draft](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft): export an existing timeline without rerunning remote stages, preserve media, and verify the target editor rather than assuming universal compatibility.
- [Workbench docs](https://zenstory.ai/docs): getting started, user guide, advanced, reference, troubleshooting (English and Chinese).
- [Organization overview](https://zenstory.ai/projects): which project to start with, based on what you want to make.
- [Oh Story changelog](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
